reference_style: match the uploaded reference video: dark canvas, centered white text, thin cyan line graphics, circular cursor/pen indicator, hand-drawn arrow movement, minimal UI, smooth slow teaching animation
title: Grover's Algorithm

visual_style.background: dark charcoal black with a very subtle dotted grid
visual_style.cursor: small white glowing pen/cursor with cyan circular focus ring

scenes.cursor: cyan circle appears below the text and slowly moves

scenes.text: We want to find one state.
scenes.cursor: moves between the states and stops on |11⟩

scenes.visual: cursor draws a thin cyan circle around |11⟩ and draws an arrow toward it
two horizontal quantum wires are drawn from left to right

scenes.text: Apply a Hadamard gate to both qubits.
scenes.visual: cursor draws an H gate box on q0, then another H gate box on q1
scenes.cursor: cyan circle follows the drawing and pauses after each gate

scenes.text: Now all four states have equal probability.
scenes.visual: four simple probability bars are hand-drawn
scenes.cursor: points to each bar one by one

scenes.text: The oracle marks the state we are searching for.
scenes.visual: cursor moves to the circuit and draws the oracle section around the relevant gates
scenes.cursor: draws a thin cyan outline around the oracle and points toward |11⟩

scenes.text: Then the diffuser amplifies its amplitude.
scenes.visual: cursor draws the diffuser section after the oracle

scenes.text: The probability of our target becomes much larger.
scenes.visual: probability bars animate from equal heights toward a dominant |11⟩ bar
scenes.cursor: moves to the |11⟩ bar and draws a cyan arrow toward it
scenes.qsphere: briefly show the corresponding state representation beside the circuit

scenes.text: Measure, and we find the marked state.
scenes.visual: measurement symbols appear at the end of the circuit and |11⟩ becomes the final highlighted result
scenes.cursor: moves to the measurement and then to |11⟩

narration_style.synchronization: cursor and drawings must follow narration exactly
